items.en: It’s all about the frame of mind.
When you’re exploring this exhibition, it’s all about the frame of mind you bring to each piece.

groups.titleZh: I’m looking for that sweet spot between X and Y.

I appreciate that perspective, but I am looking at it from a different angle, especially considering the long-term costs.

groups.titleZh: Fair enough, but let us look at the practical side of things.
groups.intro: 用 Fair enough 給予尊重，再用 practical 拉回你的理性核心。

items.en: Fair enough, but let us look at the practical side of things.
Fair enough, but let us look at the practical side of things. Can we actually pull this off by Friday?

groups.titleZh: I am not entirely sold on that idea yet, tell me more.
groups.intro: 既表達了懷疑（直率），又給了對方解釋的機會（禮貌）。

items.en: I am not entirely sold on that idea yet, tell me more.
Actually, I am not entirely sold on that idea yet, tell me more about how you plan to execute it.

groups.titleZh: That is one way to look at it, but here is another possibility.
groups.intro: 不否定對方，而是提供一個並列的選項。

items.en: That is one way to look at it, but here is another possibility.
That is one way to look at it, but here is another possibility that might be more efficient for us.

sections.subtitle: 西岸風格的俐落結尾

groups.titleZh: I will let you get back to what you were doing.
groups.intro: 極具美式禮貌，暗示「我不想佔用你的時間」，其實也可以是你想離開了。

items.en: I will let you get back to what you were doing.
It was great catching up, but I will let you get back to what you were doing. See you around!

groups.titleZh: I have a few more things to check off my list today.
groups.intro: 展現你的高效形象，讓離開顯得很合理。

items.en: I have a few more things to check off my list today.
I would love to chat more, but I have a few more things to check off my list today. Let’s talk soon.

groups.titleZh: Let us pick this up again when we both have more time.
groups.intro: 留下未來的連結，但優雅地結束當下的對話。

items.en: Let us pick this up again when we both have more time.
This was a solid discussion. Let us pick this up again when we both have more time next week.

groups.titleZh: I am going to make a quick move, but it was a pleasure talking to you.
groups.intro: make a quick move 是一種隨性且自然的撤退說法。

items.en: I am going to make a quick move, but it was a pleasure talking to you.
I am going to make a quick move, but it was a pleasure talking to you about the real estate exam.

groups.titleZh: Keep me posted on how that develops.
groups.intro: 非常好的結束語，展現你持續關心的態度。

items.en: Keep me posted on how that develops.
Good luck with the project. Keep me posted on how that develops!
